title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji decided to take the initiative and set a trap to draw out the snake, that窥探的目光 mysteriously vanished the moment he closed his net—the other party seemed to have already anticipated his move.

text.content: Night wind carried the sound of pine waves across the cliff edge. Chen Ji's fingertips hovered at the edge of that blurred foresight vision. The full picture of the Holy Sect's plan had already taken shape in his mind, except for that one chaotic fragment interfered with by Chen Nian—a thorn piercing his heart, making sleep impossible. "If rescuing Nian'er's price is releasing an existence even the Eyes of Heaven fear..." he silently recited, yet his lips curved into a self-deprecating arc. His knuckles gently tapped the stone table, rhythm steady as placing a chess piece.

dialogue.content: "What are you thinking about so intently?" A cold female voice sounded from behind, accompanied by a faint scent of blood. Chen Ji didn't need to turn around to know who it was—the Demon Path Holy Sect's Saint Maiden Ye Qing, approaching under the moonlight, her crimson flowing dress fluttering in the night wind like a burning karmic fire.

Chen Ji slowly turned, his gaze平静如古井: "Thinking about a question I暂时没有答案." His tone was indifferent, as if discussing today's weather, "Saint Maiden visits so late at night, surely not for moon viewing."

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, her slender fingers toying with a strand of blue silk: "Naturally not." She lowered her voice, a trace of solemnity flickering between her brows, "News from the Holy Sect—the Heavenly Fate Lock's seal is loosening. We're running out of time, Chen Ji."

text.content: Before she finished speaking, Chen Ji's gaze abruptly turned sharp. He raised his hand to stop Ye Qing from continuing, his eyes sweeping like a hawk toward the dark dense forest east of the cliff. The pine wave sounds seemed to become tumultuous at that same instant, as if someone was whispering in the shadows. His knuckles tightened slightly, an indescribable vigilance crawling from his tailbone to the back of his head—someone was monitoring.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing followed his gaze, her pupils slightly contracting. She calmly stepped back half a pace, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji, her voice extremely low: "You sensed it?" Her fingers subtly formed seals, demonic energy beginning to flow around her body, ready to strike at any moment.

"Don't move." Chen Ji's voice was as light as a sigh, "The other party comes with ill intent; those with good intent don't come. Acting rashly will only alert the snake." His lips almost touched Ye Qing's ear, breath warm, "And... I need to first弄清楚, which side does this uninvited guest belong to."

text.content: Ye Qing's form stiffened slightly, clearly uncomfortable with such close contact. But she quickly suppressed the unease, obediently收敛了气息. Moonlight fell, illuminating the two standing side by side. In the shadows, an intangible gaze始终锁定着这边, like a snake flicking its tongue, icy and piercing.

dialogue.content: "The alliance's eyes are more arrogant than we imagined." Ye Qing's voice was cold as ice, "I told you long ago, the alliance has混进了不该有的人. Those '废物同门' of yours may one day bite you." Her words were meaningful, clearly with hidden implications.

Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips反而弯起一个莫测的弧度. He raised his hand to brush a strand of hair blown messy by the wind at Ye Qing's temple, the gesture affectionate like comforting a frightened little beast: "Saint Maiden rest assured, since I dare to meet here at the cliff, I naturally have把握让某些人看见我愿意让他们看见的东西."

text.content: His fingers gently tapped Ye Qing's shoulder—that was their pre-arranged signal: execute the plan. In the next instant, Chen Ji's voice abruptly rose, carrying a playful, world-weary laziness: "Since Saint Maiden is here, why not accompany Chen Mou in appreciating the moonlight? Life as废物 at Tianqing Sect is truly dull;难得有人愿意听我说几句废话."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing愣了一下, then understood his intent. She cooperatively掩唇轻笑, her brows and eyes revealing a hint of coquettishness: "Young Master Chen has好兴致, however..." Her gaze intentionally or unintentionally swept across that dense forest, "I wonder, among your so-called '废话', how many are true?"

text.content: The gaze in the shadows seemed even more凝实了, Chen Ji could almost feel the urgency and greed contained in that窥探. He冷笑 in his heart—上钩了. The other party was eager to confirm his relationship with the Demon Saint, so he'd let them confirm enough. After all, the real plan was never on the surface.

choice.prompt: The暗处的监视者正等着捕捉破绽, how should Chen Ji应对这潜在的威胁?

choices.description: Secretly mobilize resources, follow the trail to find the监视者's identity, and eliminate the risk of intelligence leakage from the source.
choices.visible_cost: Consume time and energy, may alert the snake
choices.visible_reward: Uncover traitors within the alliance and eliminate hidden dangers
choices.risk_hint: The other party's background is unclear; rash investigation may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his pupils reflecting that幽暗的密林. A blurred figure flashed within—a thin build, yet the gait carried a familiar rhythm. His heart stirred; this gait... seemed to have been seen somewhere before.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." He murmured, the curve of his lips carrying a playful air, "Ye Qing, help me investigate one person—disciples who frequently enter the藏经阁 recently, especially those who seem to have no交集 with me yet always appear at critical moments."

choices.description: Pretend not to notice abnormalities, feed false intelligence to the监视者, turning the traitor into a tool for transmitting incorrect information.
choices.visible_cost: Intelligence continues to leak; rescue plan risk increases
choices.visible_reward: Turn the tables, use the traitor to transmit false intelligence
choices.risk_hint: If the监视者察觉 the intent early, may set up a counter-trap

text.content: Chen Ji收回目光, looking at Ye Qing again, his voice carrying appropriate playfulness: "Since someone likes to listen to stories, let them listen their fill." His fingertip drew a trace on the stone table—that was a rune only Ye Qing could understand—反饵.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's eyes sparkled, then concealed that fleeting admiration. She stepped forward, her slender finger gently tapping Chen Ji's chest, her voice soft enough to drip water: "Young Master Chen, you are truly an... interesting person."

text.content: No matter which path is chosen, that gaze in the shadows始终如影随形. Chen Ji's heart弦绷得更紧了—this监视者's patience exceeded expectations;绝非普通眼线. If this person cannot be quickly uncovered, the plan to rescue Chen Nian will collapse from within.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly leaned close to Chen Ji's ear, her breath幽冷: "My Holy Sect has a secret术 that can track the气息残留 of窥探者. If you trust me, within three days, I'll give you an answer." Her tone became rarely serious, "But you must tell me, what exactly have you discovered."

text.content: Under the moonlight, Chen Ji's face was half bright, half dark. He沉思片刻, finally speaking, his voice low as if自言自语: "I suspect... the监视者 is not just one person." He raised his hand, pointing to three inconspicuous shadows in the dense forest, "Just now, three breaths took turns appearing, as if covering each other. This手法,绝非寻常弟子能为."

Ye Qing's脸色微变. Following Chen Ji's finger, even with her cultivation, she only sensed one of the breaths. "Are you saying..." Her voice tightened, "Within Tianqing Sect, someone has formed an intelligence network specifically targeting you?"

choice.prompt: The existence of an intelligence network complicates the situation further; Chen Ji must make a decision.

choices.description: Since the other party has already formed a network, why not turn the tables—create false intelligence to make the insiders suspicion each other, collapsing them from within.
choices.visible_cost: Requires meticulous布局, consumes mental energy
choices.visible_reward: Wipe them all out, thoroughly eliminate internal hidden dangers
choices.risk_hint: If布局 shows flaws, may lose everything

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that笑容在月光下显得格外清冷. He took out a jade slip from his sleeve, crushing it to powder before Ye Qing: "Since they want intelligence, I'll give them a '大礼'."

dialogue.content: "In three days, I'll deliberately reveal a fake rescue date." Chen Ji's eyes闪烁着算计的光芒, "Let them race to send this 'intelligence' out—then we follow the trail to see whose vine this melon grows on."

choices.description: Continue pretending ignorance, let the other party relax their guard, wait for them to露出更大的破绽.
choices.visible_cost: Intelligence continues to leak during this period
choices.visible_reward: The other party may露出更致命的马脚
choices.risk_hint: The other party may先下手为强

text.content: "Not urgent." Chen Ji shook his head, his voice revealing a strange composure, "The moment猎物 is most vulnerable is not when it's first targeted, but when it thinks it has succeeded."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing凝视着他, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. This seemingly废物 man, his心思竟深沉如渊. "Alright." She轻轻颔首, "I'll wait with you. But if they strike first, I'll protect you."

text.content: Night wind grew cold, that窥探的目光 finally slowly retreated. Chen Ji望着密林深处, his eyes深沉的墨色. He knew this was merely the calm before the storm. Within three days, a暗网 set up against him will collide head-on with the棋局 he personally woven. Who is the hunter, who is the prey? The answer will soon be revealed.
